predecessors.name: Kingdom of Samoa
predecessors.text: 'the islands of Upolu, Savai'i, Apolima and Manono'

successors.name: New Zealand
successors.text: German Samoa, which New Zealand 'occupied ... through to 1920' and governed 'as a League of Nations Class C Mandate'

ledger.x: 1900: Germany raises its flag over Samoa (1 March 1900): the colonial period 'officially began with the raising of the imperial flag on 1 March 1900', after the Tripartite Convention (signed 2 December 1899, ratified 16 February 1900) divided the Samoan Islands; 'consisting of the islands of Upolu, Savai'i, Apolima…
1914: New Zealand occupies German Samoa: the colony 'was invaded unopposed on the morning of 29 August 1914 by troops of the Samoa Expeditionary Force' (infobox 'NZ occupation: 30 August 1914').
1920: the occupation becomes a mandate: infobox 'League mandate: 17 December 1920'; New Zealand governed the islands 'as a League of Nations Class C Mandate'.
1920: New Zealand receives the Class C mandate over the former German colony (17 December 1920).
1920: German Samoa ends as a state with the mandate.

wars.name: New Zealand occupation of German Samoa (First World War)
wars.outcome: 'invaded unopposed on the morning of 29 August 1914'; held under New Zealand occupation to the mandate of 17 December 1920.

certainty.note: An island group fixed by the Tripartite Convention of 1899 (the line between German and American Samoa); the border is the sea.
